svg.title: Manchester precursors and one fitted α-pinene particle-aging pathway
svg.desc: Skeletal structures of α-pinene, o-cresol and isoprene, and a separate proposed pinic acid assignment from the Manchester composition study. The structures show connectivity without assigning stereochemistry. A selected model pathway couples two α-pinene-derived particle intermediates into dimer material. Retained oxidation and then cleavage put half of the transferred organic mass into a particle residue and half into gas. All downstream pools have unassigned molecular structures.
svg.metadata: Structures drawn from PubChem two-dimensional records for CID 6654, 335, 6557 and 10131. Pinic acid was a tentative assignment in Shao et al. (2022), Figure 6a, https://doi.org/10.5194/acp-22-9799-2022 . Model channels aa_particle, AA_oxidize and AA_oxsplit from studies/voliotis-2022/joint/results/chains/resolution_checked_mechanism.json. S_AA,p and D_AA refer to the same dimer mass inventory.

g.text: An α-pinene pathway from the fitted mechanism
Each model pool groups organic material with an unresolved molecular structure.
